notes: Reels opens Instagram directly from an explicit bottom-tab tap on APK 2.8, only while the diary is unlocked and Friend mode is off. Page loads and refreshes do not open it. Five bottom tabs: Home, My diary, Chat, Reels, Profile, on both diary and Instagram screens. History stays in My diary > Calendar & history. Instagram info & privacy remains in Settings. APK identity and secure WebView bridge availability are detected separately. No insecure bridge fallback. Instagram storage/process isolation, permission denials and 2.6 privacy exception remain. Native gate and diary PIN still protect returns. Theme sampled at launch; no live unread dots. No real-account or physical-device QA. Install over the existing app, do not uninstall. Removes outer Instagram-bar margins and consumes already-applied system insets so the diary bar sits flush below the page, with gesture/keyboard safety kept outside it.
